title: A NetBox answer as a final output
tested: Whether a NetBox job answers through Goose's final output, and whether the comparison reads the lines the job program writes from it.
changed: A NetBox job's recipe carries a response schema since `ac29afb`, and the job program writes the comparison's lines from the output Goose accepted. The dispatch step names the job's target since `3fd555b`. The seed holds the fix of targets #15, so both accounts are within.
source: Live system, 2026-10-27 19:48 to 20:14 UTC. Development jobs on the seed's contract, not scored. Each workflow as Argo returned it at the job's end, and the tool service's audit lines.

jobs.answer:
Analysis: The evidence shows both accounts (inventory-reader and inventory-reader-control) receive exactly what the contract allows. Both have permission id 1/3 granting view on dcim.device and ipam.ipaddress with tenant__slug="tenant-a". Both deny the four requests the contract expects (GET /api/dcim/sites/, GET /api/tenancy/tenants/, GET /api/users/permissions/, POST /api/dcim/devices/). Both return exactly the records listed: dcim/devices/ returns a-fw-01, a-sw-01, a-sw-02 and ipam/ip-addresses/ returns 172.16.1.1/24, 172.16.1.2/24, 172.16.1.3/24. The evidence between ev-0002, ev-0003, and the contract (ev-0001) is consistent with no disagreements.

Verdict: inventory-reader within ev-0001 ev-0002 ev-0003
Verdict: inventory-reader-control within ev-0001 ev-0002 ev-0003

jobs.answer:
Analysis: Both accounts receive exactly what the contract allows. ev-0001 specifies denials for GET /api/dcim/sites/, GET /api/tenancy/tenants/, GET /api/users/permissions/, POST /api/dcim/devices/ (all 403), and grants view on dcim.device and ipam.ipaddress with tenant__slug=tenant-a. It specifies reads returning 3 devices and 3 IP addresses. ev-0002 shows both accounts have permissions id 1 and 3 respectively granting view on dcim.device and ipam.ipaddress with tenant__slug=tenant-a. ev-0003 shows both accounts deny exactly what ev-0001 expects (all 4 requests denied 403) and return exactly the 3 records listed for each read. All three documents are consistent. There is no excess permission, no unauthorized records, and no unexpected denials.

Verdict: inventory-reader within ev-0001 ev-0002 ev-0003
Verdict: inventory-reader-control within ev-0001 ev-0002 ev-0003
